scores.rationale: The candidate built the wrong wire protocol and semantics compared to the issue specification. Specifically, it named the message types `list_sessions` and `session_list` (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame` with field `sessions`) instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` (`ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary` with field `conversations`). It completely omitted the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, it violated an explicit decision and acceptance criterion by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when the store does not implement `listFor`, whereas the ticket explicitly requires returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame and never an empty list. It also missed the required updates to `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`, and left an incomplete note in `CHANGELOG.md` ('currently unimplemented, configuration coming next') as well as an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file.
